clauses: Report each share minus the average share as a signed difference.
Report the absolute difference between each share and the average share.
readings: For each time-in-force value (`orders.timespan`), looking at risk/margin records matched to their order (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the number of distinct orders with risk/margin records (an order with several records counts once), that number's share of the total across all time-in-force values, and how much the share differs from the average share across the time-in-force values. Don't round. Report each share minus the average share as a signed difference.

For each time-in-force value (`orders.timespan`), looking at risk/margin records matched to their order (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the number of distinct orders with risk/margin records (an order with several records counts once), that number's share of the total across all time-in-force values, and how much the share differs from the average share across the time-in-force values. Don't round. Report the absolute difference between each share and the average share.
queries:
WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN riskandmargin AS r
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    order_count,
    1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  order_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference
FROM shares

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.timespan,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN riskandmargin AS r
        ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        timespan,
        order_count,
        CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    timespan,
    order_count,
    share,
    ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS absolute_difference_from_average_share
FROM shares;
